flags.title: Hidden controls can be tabbed to
flags.detail: 2 tab stops land on controls inside a hidden region (for example: button "Close bag" inside div.fixed.inset-0 aria-hidden; a "Shop all" inside div.fixed.inset-0 aria-hidden), usually a closed menu, drawer or modal.

flags.title: Links open new tabs without saying so
flags.detail: 7 links use target="_blank" with no "(opens in new tab)" hint (for example: Loved Beauty on Instagram, Loved Beauty on TikTok, Instagram, TikTok).

flags.title: Page breaks at 400% zoom
flags.detail: At 320px wide the page scrolls sideways by 6px (li.shrink-0, a.link-underline.text-[0.7rem], li.shrink-0). Low-vision users who zoom cannot read it.
